query: with titles(title) as (values ('Leçon 1 : Les réactions émotionnelles chez l’Homme.'),('Leçon 2 : L’activité cérébrale chez l’Homme.'),('Leçon 1 : L’origine de la vie.')), target_lessons as (select s.name as series_name,c.id as chapter_id,c.title as chapter_title,c.display_order as chapter_order,l.id as lesson_id,l.title as lesson_title,l.display_order as lesson_order,l.is_active,coalesce(length(l.content),0) as content_length,(select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id=l.id) as exercise_count,(select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id=l.id) as quiz_count from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id=l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id=c.subject_offering_id join public.series s on s.id=o.series_id join public.levels lv on lv.id=o.level_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id=o.subject_id where lv.name='Terminale' and sub.name='Sciences de la Vie et de la Terre' and s.name in ('A1','A2','C','D') and l.title in (select title from titles)), a2_offering as (select o.id as offering_id,coalesce((select max(c.display_order) from public.chapters c where c.subject_offering_id=o.id),0) as max_chapter_order,(select count(*) from public.chapters c where c.subject_offering_id=o.id) as chapter_count from public.course_subject_offerings o join public.levels lv on lv.id=o.level_id join public.series s on s.id=o.series_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id=o.subject_id where lv.name='Terminale' and s.name='A2' and sub.name='Sciences de la Vie et de la Terre') select jsonb_build_object('targets',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(target_lessons) order by series_name,chapter_order,lesson_order) from target_lessons),'a2_offering',(select to_jsonb(a2_offering) from a2_offering)) as audit limit 1;
